caption: The drawing depicts a cape-like garment featuring a vivid design. The upper portion consists of a broad, structured collar and shoulder covering rendered in a rich, solid red color. Decorative elements in the form of blue, gold, and red linear patterns accent the edges and seams of this higher section. The lower portion of the garment transitions into a cloak with a brown background densely covered in large, round, red floral motifs, each with a yellow center and outlined details in lighter yellow or gold. The cloak appears voluminous and falls in draped folds, while the decorative pattern is evenly distributed across the visible fabric. The overall composition centers the garment, displayed from the back, against a plain, off-white background.
title: Cape
